## Purpose

Describe the change and its scientific or usability rationale.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests were run; report path and tested HTML hash are provided.
- [ ] Changes to equations include a primary reference, units, domain and fixed-input comparison.
- [ ] pt-BR and en-US text, unavailable states and grid changes were considered.
- [ ] No credentials or private station data are included.
- [ ] Historical reports have not been relabeled as new validation.
- [ ] Model limitations and citation/version metadata were updated where necessary.

## Remaining limitations

List untested browsers, external services, reference disagreements and assumptions.
